method: Standard tennis scoring state machine: a regular game ends when a player has at least four points and a two-point lead, with 0, 15, 30, 40, deuce and advantage labels. A set ends at six games with a two-game lead; at 6-all, a tiebreak ends at seven or more points with a two-point lead and completes the set 7-6. Two set wins end the best-of-three match. Each point awards only the selected player; game, set and match transitions reset exactly the state required by the rules. Undo restores the complete prior state, and scoring is refused after the match. Serving rotation, changeovers, lets, no-ad scoring, super tiebreaks and officials' decisions are not modelled. Names and scores remain only in page memory.

sources.title: International Tennis Federation, Rules of Tennis: scoring in a game, scoring in a set and match, and the tie-break game
